kontrata.title: Kontrata
kontrata.description: End-to-end ATS (Applicant Tracking System) for Grupo Koch, still in staging: it covers everything from job posting to the final step of the process, onboarding the new hire into Senior ERP. It is a monorepo with four pieces — the API (Node 24 + Hono + OpenAPI), the candidate portal (Next.js 16 with a BFF), the recruiter portal (Vite + React + TanStack Router SPA) and the queue system (13 BullMQ/Redis queues handled by a dedicated worker) that runs AI résumé analysis, pgvector-based talent-pool ranking, background checks and the admission handoff to Senior. Once live, it replaces two third-party tools the company pays for today, Recrut.ai and Senior's Collab, so both subscriptions can be cancelled. Being an internal project, it has no public URL or repository available.

meeting-voice-reports.title: Meeting Voice Reports
meeting-voice-reports.description: A full-stack app that transcribes meetings, interviews, and scheduling calls in real time and generates a structured report when the session ends. Speech recognition runs 100% in the browser through the Web Speech API (no STT cost and no audio leaving the device); the Fastify backend accumulates the final transcript chunks and, on finalize, a LangGraph graph extracts the report via LLM (OpenRouter), validated against a Zod schema specific to each session type. The frontend is a React 19 + Vite PWA with paragraph-grouped transcription, an audio level meter, screen wake lock, and resumable recording, and the finished report can be emailed to multiple recipients through Resend.

resumo-diario-de-frota.title: Daily Fleet Summary
resumo-diario-de-frota.description: Internal service at Grupo Koch that collects, via IMAP, the previous day's vehicle-tracking alerts sent by Link Monitoramento, generates a structured summary with OpenAI (Structured Outputs) — event counting and categorization, risk-ranked vehicles, time patterns and speed excess — and distributes it by email through the internal email microservice, with deterministic markdown/HTML rendering done in code. Runs as a persistent process with daily scheduling via node-cron, with the collection window's timezone computed explicitly to avoid drift. Being an internal project, it has no public URL or available repository.

giehl-dev-toolkit.title: Giehl Dev Toolkit
giehl-dev-toolkit.description: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace, bringing together skills, MCP servers, and other automations (commands, subagents, hooks) with patterns and best practices used day-to-day in development. The catalog is a marketplace.json at the repository root, with each plugin in its own directory under plugins/, containing its manifest (SKILL.md with frontmatter, or plugin.json) and implementation. Installing on any machine takes a single command (claude plugin marketplace add + /plugin install), eliminating manual file copying between projects. First published plugin: structured-prompt-engineering, a skill documenting the pattern of writing getSystemPrompt/getUserPromptTemplate as serialized objects via JSON.stringify (role, rules, extraction_instructions, examples), with complete few-shot examples and a list of do's and don'ts derived from real production prompts.

gestao-de-projetos-mcp.title: Gestão de Projetos MCP
gestao-de-projetos-mcp.description: A Claude Code plugin that integrates the assistant with an internal corporate Project Management system via a TypeScript MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. It exposes 39 tools and 4 guided flows that allow creating and tracking projects, managing activities and workflow stages, logging hours, recording blockers, and prioritizing initiatives via WSJF scoring — all directly in conversation. Authentication uses Active Directory credentials, with access tokens and automatic refresh in httpOnly cookies, and RBAC permission enforcement. The standout feature is the log_week_hours flow, which reads the local git history, maps commits to projects/activities, and distributes the week's hours automatically. Validation with Zod and ESM bundle with esbuild. As an internal integration, it has no public URL or repository.

orchestrator-agent.title: Orchestrator Agent
orchestrator-agent.description: A corporate AI assistant platform that centralizes internal interactions via chat. It uses orchestrated agents with the OpenAI Responses API, semantic search with embeddings, LDAP/Active Directory authentication, and integration with legacy corporate systems. Includes operational process automation, async queues with Redis/BullMQ, and Telegram integration as an additional channel. Built with Next.js 16 and containerized with Docker.

gestao-de-despesas.title: Gestão de Despesas
gestao-de-despesas.description: An internal web application (Next.js 15 + React 19) for a retail company to manage non-resale purchase expenses. It receives invoices already extracted by a dedicated ingestion worker and routes each one through an eight-role approval flow (buyer, approver, controller, fiscal, finance, admin, manager, regional manager), with value-based thresholds, escalation, vacation substitutes, DIFAL tax calculation, urgent-payment emails, and automatic back-integration with the corporate ERP. Scheduled jobs and async queues (Redis/BullMQ) orchestrate background processing. As an internal project, it has no public URL or repository.

gestao-despesas-ingestor.title: Gestão de Despesas — Ingestor
gestao-despesas-ingestor.description: A fiscal-document ingestion worker (Node.js/TypeScript, hexagonal architecture) that feeds the Gestão de Despesas system. It watches network folders in real time, extracts invoices from XML (direct parsing) or PDF/image (LLM with structured output), validates the data with a fiscal rules engine (CNPJ, NF-e access key, values), and persists header and line items to OracleDB in a single transaction, routing each document to human review when the confidence score is low. Includes value/due-date normalization, a second extractor for outsourced-service descriptions, and a daily SFTP export job for already-integrated invoices. As an internal project, it has no public URL or repository.

langchain-rag-lab.title: LangChain RAG Lab
langchain-rag-lab.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) case study built with Next.js and LangChain, focused on the trade-offs of running RAG on free-tier resources (free-tier models, low-dimensional embeddings, and quantization). Supports loading documents (.txt, .md, .pdf), previewing how they are split into chunks, generating embeddings via HuggingFace Inference API (384d), and persisting vectors in PostgreSQL + pgvector (HNSW / cosine index). The chat responds via streaming through OpenRouter, displaying retrieved sources with similarity scores and fine-grained control over each pipeline parameter (splitter, topK, temperature, top_p, penalties, and system prompt). OOP domain layer with environment validated by Zod, deployed on Vercel + Supabase.

voting-lists.title: Voting Lists
voting-lists.description: A voting list creation system built with Next.js. Each user can create lists, add participants, register candidates, and follow results in real time. Supports public and private lists, email invitations, voting restricted to participants, ranking with percentages, and light/dark themes.

vinyl-store.title: Vinyl Store
vinyl-store.description: A complete e-commerce platform specialized in vinyl records. Built with a minimalist full-stack architecture using Express, it implements cookie-based HTTP authentication with sessions persisted in PostgreSQL. Features intuitive browsing, a search system, a shopping cart, and responsive design for collectors and analog music lovers.

hero.intro: 2+ years building end-to-end solutions, from frontend to backend. I'm currently a mid-level developer at Grupo Koch SA, specializing in AI: I build multi-agent platforms with Claude Code, opencode, and OpenAI, plus RAG pipelines and corporate process automation.

experience.title: Experience & Stack
experience.p1: I'm currently a mid-level developer at Grupo Koch SA, where I specialize in AI applied to corporate platform development with multi-agent integration. I use tools like Claude Code, opencode, and OpenAI to orchestrate agents that automate processes and centralize internal interactions.
experience.p2: With more than 2 years of experience, I've built a solid foundation in the frontend ecosystem with TanStack, shadcn/ui, Zod, and Tailwind CSS, plus good testing habits with Jest and Cypress. On the backend I work with Node.js and Next.js (Server Actions), OracleDB and PostgreSQL / pgvector, async queues with Redis and BullMQ, and integrations with ERPs and legacy systems. I also build RAG pipelines and LLM-based document ingestion with LangChain, OpenAI, and HuggingFace.
